_meta.note: PROVISIONAL — All R_p scores are synthetic baselines derived from published aggregate data. omega_p weights derived from Foran 2005 (GHG split), Newmont 2024 SR (cyanide spills, water recycled, land reclaimed), and WGC 2019. Phase-resolved LCA calibration required before operational use.
sources: Foran et al. 2005 Balancing Act Vol 2
_meta.formula_tvpci_r: TVPCI_R = sum(omega_p * B_r_p) for p in 0..7
_meta.role_assignment: TVPCI plays D (bounding, defining forward structure); TVPCI_R plays C (integrating, returning ecological flow); B_chain is emergent N (negotiated child-holon state with parent)

0.dominant_waste: Drill cuttings; land disturbance from access roads
0.score_note: Minimal public reporting on exploration-phase ecological impacts. Policy exists at corporate level but site-specific monitoring is sparse.

1.dominant_waste: Tailings slurry; acid mine drainage; waste rock overburden
1.score_note: Best-reported extraction phase. Newmont TSF data and reclamation records inform D_r; independent TSF inspection compliance is partial. D_r elevated due to ICMM Tailings Standard adoption; C_r constrained by limited third-party community audits.

2.dominant_waste: Cyanide solution; process water; SO2 from roasting
2.score_note: Highest-scoring recycling phase despite highest omega_p. Cyanide Code and stack permitting provide D_r structure. Third-party stack tests and cyanide spill audits (Newmont Path to Zero) raise C_r. Highest weighted contribution to TVPCI_R.

3.dominant_waste: Smelter slag; SO2/NOx; mercury capture waste
3.score_note: Smelter reporting is less standardised than leach-phase reporting. Slag characterisation is inconsistent across operators. C_r low due to limited independent furnace emissions testing at this phase specifically.

4.dominant_waste: Acid pickling liquors; chlorine gas; anode slime
4.score_note: LBMA refiner listing provides D_r structure. Acid discharge permitting is jurisdiction-specific and not uniformly verified. Third-party acid effluent testing is uncommon at this phase; C_r reflects that gap.

5.dominant_waste: Metal filings; assay cupel waste (lead/silver); lubricants
5.score_note: Filings recovery is standard industry practice but rarely independently verified. Cupel waste hazardous classification is inconsistently documented. Overall low scores reflect low visibility of this phase's ecological reporting.

6.dominant_waste: Transport diesel exhaust; vault HVAC energy
6.score_note: Low waste intensity but also low ecological reporting. HVAC energy reporting is minimal. Transport emissions are rarely attributed to individual custody legs. Low omega_p limits impact on aggregate.

7.score_note: Highest B_r despite moderate N/D/C because D_r and C_r are relatively close. Exchange sustainability reports (CME Group, LME/HKEX) provide some public disclosure. Near-zero physical waste. Negligible impact on aggregate due to low omega_p.

synthetic.tvpci_role: D — the bounding forward custody structure
synthetic.tvpci_r_role: C — the integrating ecological return flow
synthetic.b_chain_role: N — emergent negotiated state of the child holon with its parent
synthetic.interpretation: The chain scores 82.5 on forward custody transparency but only 49.9 on ecological return transparency. The resulting B_chain of 45.4 falls in the Failure zone (below phi-complement threshold of 38.2 is breakdown; 45.4 is in Failure zone). The positive delta_chain of +32.6 indicates the chain is substantially over-defining (extracting and claiming) relative to its ecological return contribution. This is the expected condition for the current gold industry benchmark.

current.label: Current State
current.description: Industry synthetic baseline. Forward custody strong; ecological return accountability at Failure zone.

optimum.label: All Optimum
optimum.description: Best-case scenario. Even at maximum custody transparency, ecological return lags — reflecting the structural gap between what is commercially auditable and what is ecologically accounted for. B_chain improves to Stressed zone.

shock_1.label: Vaulting Shock
shock_1.description: Custody crisis. Ecological transparency collapses proportionally — crisis conditions reduce reporting discipline. B_chain worsens but delta_chain narrows slightly.

shock_2.label: Mining Strike
shock_2.description: Major upstream supply shock. Mine closures suspend both custody reporting and ecological monitoring. B_chain falls to Breakdown zone. Worst b_chain of all scenarios.

expansion.label: Expansion
expansion.description: Scale-up scenario. More throughput means more waste generation; ecological reporting does not scale proportionally with volume. B_chain improves only marginally vs current despite higher TVPCI.

regulatory.label: Regulatory
regulatory.description: Enhanced regulatory scenario. Mandatory ecological reporting requirements close the gap between TVPCI and TVPCI_R more than any other scenario. Best B_chain of all non-optimum scenarios. Delta_chain narrows to 16.0 — closest to balance achieved under realistic conditions.

zone_thresholds.note: Same phi-derived thresholds as primary TVPCI scoring: coherent >= 80, stressed >= 61.8, failure >= 38.2, breakdown < 38.2
